interpretation.normalized_cost: GTSAM error is half the whitened residual sum of squares; use 2*error for RSS.
interpretation.dof: m-n assumes full local column rank; no new global rank factorization is performed.
interpretation.subgroup_dof: Per-family RSS/row is descriptive, not a family chi-square statistic after shared-state fitting.
interpretation.source_attribution: A large family contribution locates tension in the fitted source graph; it does not identify which physical sensor caused it.
interpretation.coordinates: Whitened coordinates can mix correlated physical residual components; no metre or acceleration error is inferred from b.
interpretation.indices: State indices identify source events, not seconds; exact physical times require joining the original event mapping.
interpretation.calibration: Stationarity and fitted process parameters do not establish source-model calibration or physical sliding identification.

physical_source_residuals.scope: Saved chart and original source events only; no optimization, noise changes, reference, shifts or navigation

gnss_source_semantics.velocity_decoder: little-endian int32 payload offsets 48/52/56 (full frame 54/58/62), millimetres/second multiplied by 0.001
gnss_source_semantics.velocity_frame: receiver local NED; subsequently rotated by real_data to its fixed NED origin
gnss_source_semantics.receiver_internal_velocity_filter_or_Dop: NOT_ESTABLISHED_BY_PROVIDER_CODE; decoded NAV-PVT receiver navigation-velocity field, not a claim of independent instantaneous Doppler truth
gnss_source_semantics.position_source: same gnss1-raw.csv UBX-NAV-HPPOSECEF ECEF position converted to geodetic
gnss_source_semantics.matching_rule: Exact equality of HPPOSECEF and NAV-PVT payload iTOW integer milliseconds; iterate sorted HPPOSECEF keys; duplicate/missing identities rejected

legacy_process_data_path.scope: Legacy V0 status-time nearest NAV-PVT receipt-stamp match <=0.1s with ffill/bfill; current V2 regenerates P/V/time from exact payload identities

gnss_source_semantics.interpretation: Backward-difference agreement does not establish a time offset or interval-velocity origin. Current P and V are the same declared payload epoch, have zero matching/fill offset, and may still share receiver processing and temporal correlation. The observed CSV receipt lag is transport/publication timing, not a fitted correction to measurement time.
